full_name: Ibtisam Azem | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
title: 2026–2027 Fiction & Poetry Mildred Londa Weisman Fellow Independent Writer
bio: Ibtisam Azem is a novelist and journalist covering the United Nations and New York and the author of three works of fiction, including The Book of Disappearance (Syracuse University Press, 2019), longlisted for the International Booker Prize 2025.
